spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,re,json
out=open(os.environ['OUT']+'/transfer-context.jsonl','w'); f=open('inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw','rb')
for fn,enc in [('wallet-ascii.txt','ascii'),('wallet-utf16.txt','utf-16le')]:
 for line in open('store/jobs/j000001/out/'+fn,errors='replace'):
  for name in ['Edward Nigma','Oswald Cobblepot']:
   if name not in line:continue
   m=re.match(r'\s*(\d+) (.*)',line);p=int(m[1])+m[2].index(name)*(2 if enc=='utf-16le' else 1)
   f.seek(max(0,p-2048));b=f.read(4096)
   vals=[]
   for e in ['ascii','utf-16le']:
    s=b.decode(e,errors='replace');vals.extend(re.findall(r'[\x20-\x7e]{5,}',s))
   out.write(json.dumps({'offset':p,'name':name,'context':vals})+'\n')
print('context output bytes',out.tell())
PY
